Privacy policy

How Webly handles information submitted through this site.

Project enquiries

If you send an enquiry, we store the name, email, project details, and any optional contact or website information you provide. We use it to respond, understand the project, and keep a record of the conversation. Enquiries are available to the studio through its private inbox. When email receipts are enabled, our mail provider uses your email address to deliver the receipt.

Site measurement

The site counts enquiries received and clicks on any WhatsApp contact link. The conversion counters store totals and do not set tracking cookies. Submission limits help protect the form from abuse.

Links to other services

Booking, WhatsApp, and live project links may take you to another service. The destination’s privacy policy applies to the information you share there.

Your enquiry information

Contact the studio if you would like to ask about, correct, or request deletion of information you sent through the enquiry form.
